headline: GDEV Inc. (GDEV) Moves 5.5% Higher: Will This Strength Last?
summary: GDEV Inc. (GDEV) was a big mover last session on higher-than-average trading volume. The latest trend in earnings estimate revisions might not help the stock continue moving higher in the near term.
